jobs.title: Leasing Manager (Residential)
jobs.description_text: ABOUT CIM GROUP: CIM is a community-focused real estate and infrastructure owner, operator, lender, and developer. Our team of experts works together to identify and create value in real assets, benefiting the communities in which we invest. Back in 1994, our three founders focused on projects in Southern California neighborhoods. Today, we are a diverse team of 900+ employees with projects across the Americas. Our projects have delivered jobs; created comfortable places to live, work, and relax; and provided necessary and sustainable infrastructure. jobs.location_raw: Annandale, VA · Alexandria, VA · Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: The Residential Maintenance Technician reports to the Property Manager under the supervision of the Maintenance Supervisor and performs general maintenance and repair to ensure apartment units and other property facilities are maintained per CIM Group operating and safety standards. Responsibilities include diagnosing, troubleshooting, and repairing heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) units; electrical appliances, outlets, and light fixtures; plumbing, carpentry, and locks. Additional responsibilities include, but are not limited to, assisting with preparing vacant apartment units for rental and following a planned preventative maintenance schedule.

jobs.title: Manager, Accounting
jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: The Manager, Accounting is responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and GAAP compliant financial reporting for infrastructure investments across multiple asset and fund structures. This role oversees monthly and quarterly accounting, consolidations, fair value measurement, and analytical review to support portfolio performance insights and decision making. The position partners closely with portfolio management, valuations, tax, treasury, as well as internal and external auditors to ensure the integrity of financial data throughout the investment lifecycle—from acquisition through disposition. The role also contributes to new investment onboarding, transaction activity, and ongoing liquidity management within complex investment structures.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Global Consultant Relations
jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: CIM Group is a private alternatives asset manager with 30-years of experience and approximately $32 billion in assets under management. Our expertise spans private equity and credit investments across real estate and infrastructure, offering a range of funds across the risk-return spectrum as well as customized client solutions. The Institutional Client Group (ICG) builds and maintains relationships with institutional investors and intermediaries globally. ICG includes regional institutional sales teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC—primarily serving pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, and endowments—as well as the Financial Institutions Group (FIG), which serves major insurance companies and banks, and Global Consultant Relations (GCR), which works with investment consultants, OCIO providers, and other asset managers. ICG is seeking a Senior Associate to join the Global Consultant Relations (GCR) Team. This role works alongside senior team members, contributes to key fundraising initiatives, and offers direct exposure to some of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutional investors. As a visible member of a collaborative, high‑performing team, the successful candidate will take ownership of select direct client relationships, targeted prospecting efforts, and contribute to and support the overall sales strategy, building a career at a respected and growing investment firm. This position is based at our office in Los Angeles, CA.

This is an excellent opportunity for a collaborative and results-driven real estate professional who enjoys taking ownership and making a measurable impact.

jobs.description_text: We are offering a $10,000 Sign On Bonus for this position. We are designing, building, and launching 8 new satellites in the next four years. Assignments will be determined by a mix of project availability and the interests of the successful candidates. Prior FPGA-specific coursework or experience is not required. We recognize that access to FPGA courses, development boards, commercial tools, and verification environments varies among universities. We are looking for candidates with a strong foundation in digital design or software-based verification concepts and an interest in applying those skills to FPGA development. jobs.title: Summer 2027 - Electrical Engineering Internship, Hardware

On the CesiumAstro Hardware Design Team, we are responsible for full-stack hardware development for cutting-edge space electronics. We own designs from initial concept through part selection, schematic, layout, build, test, and delivery, all the way through in-orbit support. Designs encompass the spectrum of electronics design, including high-speed digital, power electronics, and RF hardware – often on the same board. We’re looking for summer interns to support our mission. Interns work side-by-side with design engineers: contributing to the company’s success is as high of a priority as learning and gaining experience. jobs.description_text: We are looking to add an Test Technician III to our team. If you are excited about working in a startup environment, have a strong work ethic, and are passionate about cutting-edge electronics, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will work closely with CesiumAstro engineers to create module & payload performance test setups, execute test plans, and produce timely, reliable test results. You will have the opportunity to use and maintain state-of-the-art electronics lab instrumentation, such as spectrum analyzers, VNAs, automated power supplies, and more. You will be challenged to propose and fabricate intricate test setups to increase productivity and improve test results. Many of our products include active phased arrays (a.k.a. active electronically scanned arrays, or AESAs). These are antenna products with active RF circuitry integrated with the antenna. This adds complexity to the test architecture, including power, digital control, and thermal effects. As such, direct experience with phased array (or AESA) testing is preferred. Core day-to-day activities will include aligning with engineers to test and troubleshoot complex electronics and RF circuitry from component level to system level. As such, the ability to understand and work from drawings, diagrams, schematics, and test procedures is key. jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Researcher – Remote (US)
jobs.location_raw: Remote, USA: AL, AZ, CO, DC, FL, GA, IL, IN, MA, MD, ME, MN, NC, NJ, NM, NY, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX, UT, VA, WI
jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

jobs.title: Communications Systems Test Engineer
jobs.description_text: We are hiring an E2E Test Automation Engineer to turn complex wireless-system validation needs into reliable automation, repeatable execution, and clear evidence of system performance. You will develop and maintain automation across wireless devices, radio access systems, network functions, lab infrastructure, and system-level interfaces. Your work will span virtualized environments, embedded devices, hardware-in-the-loop platforms, and physical laboratory equipment. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who takes responsibility for automation quality, investigates failures across system boundaries, and stays engaged until results are understood and verified. You should be comfortable writing Python, working in Linux, analyzing network traffic, and troubleshooting the dependencies that stand between a test and a dependable result.

jobs.description_text: We are looking for a hands-on Electrical Test Engineer to own electrical verification and electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) for E-Space’s integrated antenna assembly. You will build and troubleshoot electrical test setups, solder test hardware, write test software (Labview, Python), configure and run data acquisition (DAQ) systems, and operate spacecraft and instrument surrogates for verification testing. This is an electrical engineering role with substantial bench and test facility work. You will own the electrical test chain from the hardware connection through acquisition, automation, and recorded evidence. During environmental campaigns, you will work alongside the engineer responsible for mechanical testing, providing electrical test support and functional verification. On-site in Arlington, Texas. Hands-on bench work and test facility presence are required. Some travel between sites expected.

jobs.description_text: The E-Space Manufacturing team builds the world's most advanced aerospace products at high rate and high precision. As a Senior Controls Engineer, you'll architect, program, and deploy the Beckhoff-based control systems that run our robotic and precision-assembly lines. You'll be the dedicated controls owner the team needs - relieving today's reliance on a handful of people - and combine strong software design with hands-on hardware integration to deliver world-class reliability and throughput. This position reports to the Manufacturing Engineering leadership team.

jobs.title: Senior Cost Accounting Analyst
jobs.description_text: We are hiring a Senior Cost Accounting Analyst to own cost accounting and contract cost reporting for E-Space's government contracts. You will build the project cost structure, deliver the required CSDR and CDRL submissions on time, lead IPMR meetings, and set the cost rates that future government bids are priced on. This is not just a reporting role. You will design the cost codes, fix cost data at its source in the ERP and timekeeping systems, produce and submit the reports, and see the cost system you built relied on by program teams in every review, by the government customer in every submission, and by the bid team in every price. This role is for someone who takes responsibility for the result, not just the spreadsheet. You define what a correct, complete submission looks like before the work starts. You decide quickly with the data you have, and you chase errors back to the system that created them. When a deadline is at risk, you pull in the people needed to recover it and stay on it until the report is out and accepted.

jobs.description_text: The E-Space Manufacturing team builds the world's most advanced aerospace products at high rate and high precision. You'll work hands-on in SolidWorks alongside a Staff designer and the broader manufacturing team, owning subsystems end-to-end and bringing them from concept to qualified production hardware. This position reports to the Manufacturing Engineering leadership team.

jobs.title: Senior Patent Agent
jobs.description_text: About the Role E-Space designs and manufactures low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites for 5G communications, associated ground-based Internet of Things (IoT) devices, and radar systems for space-based and ground-based applications. We are seeking a Senior Patent Agent to take substantial ownership of patent preparation and prosecution across these technologies. Working directly with Lead IP Counsel and engineering teams, you will turn complex inventions into high-quality patent applications and pursue commercially meaningful claim coverage. This is a hands-on role: approximately 60% of your time will involve drafting applications, with approximately 30–40% devoted to prosecution. You will personally draft most assigned applications and all U.S. Office Action responses for assigned matters, and review outside counsel’s non-U.S. Office Action responses. The role calls for an experienced practitioner who can produce high-quality work with limited supervision and is proficient using AI-based tools effectively.

jobs.description_text: E-Space is seeking a Senior RF Front-End Design Engineer to develop transmit and receive electronics for satellite communication user terminals. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who can translate system and link requirements into robust RF hardware and take designs from architecture through device-level circuit design, PCB implementation, prototype bring-up, validation, and production release. The successful candidate will work closely with antenna, modem, baseband, firmware, power, mechanical, thermal, test, and manufacturing teams to deliver efficient and reliable user-terminal RF hardware. On-site in Arlington, Texas. Occasional travel may be required.

You'll own robotic cells end-to-end - from path planning and EOAT integration to commissioning and cycle-time optimization - and serve as the dedicated robotics owner the team needs as we scale. This is a hands-on role for someone who has deployed industrial robots in production and wants to build a robotics function from a strong foundation. This position reports to the Manufacturing Engineering leadership team.

jobs.description_text: We are hiring a Wireless Test and Automation Engineer to build and run the test systems that validate our 5G NR wireless stack. You will design and automate test cases for 3GPP Stack and PHY features, analyze L1, L2, and L3 logs to find root causes, and make sure new features are testable before they ship. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who thinks in logs, writes automation as naturally as test plans, and stays with a failure until it is understood. You should be comfortable working across software, firmware, RF, and systems teams, and ready to work in a fast-moving R&D environment.

jobs.title: Technical Buyer
jobs.description_text: The Vehicle team builds the aircraft at the heart of Rainmaker’s cloud seeding operations. We design, build, and fly autonomous drones that go where other systems won’t. Our aircraft fly into icing, turbulence, high winds, and low visibility, because that’s where the clouds worth seeding are. We own the full flight system end to end: UAS: airframe, propulsion, avionics, and the autonomy that keeps our aircraft flying safely and reliably in severe weather. Dispersion payload: the hardware that delivers seeding material precisely, at the right place and time inside a cloud. Sensing systems: onboard instruments that measure the atmosphere around the aircraft, so we can see conditions as they happen and show what each mission accomplished. We’re a small, hands-on team that takes hardware from first sketch to field deployment. Engineers here design a part, test it on the bench, and watch it fly in conditions most drone programs would ground for. If you like hard problems where the environment fights back, and you want your work to put water on the ground, you’ll fit in here.

jobs.description_text: We are seeking an experienced, proactive Lead Planner, MRO to own maintenance planning, scheduling, and material coordination for Pivotal's BlackFly and Helix eVTOL fleet. This role turns maintenance requirements, customer service requests, and engineering dispositions into execution-ready work packages, and maintains the schedule, status, and availability of every aircraft in the MRO-owned fleet. As a key cross-functional integrator, the Lead Planner, MRO partners with MRO technicians, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Flight Operations, Customer Support, and Marketing to balance customer service, fleet availability, and material readiness, while driving down aircraft downtime and giving leadership a clear, data-driven view of fleet readiness.

jobs.title: Manager, Configuration Management
jobs.description_text: About the Role The Manager, Configuration Management builds and leads Pivotal’s configuration management (CM) function. This role owns the company’s configuration management plan, serves as a key stakeholder on the Change Control Board (CCB), and is accountable for accurate, traceable product configuration for all Pivotal aircraft, hardware, and software, from initial design release through production, delivery, and in-service support. This individual will lead a team of configuration specialists and engineers, set CM policy and governance in 3DEXPERIENCE (PLM) and Epicor (ERP), and partner with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and customer support leaders to scale change control as Pivotal grows production and works toward certification. The role is critical to product integrity, certification traceability, and audit readiness.

jobs.title: Senior Battery Engineering Technician
jobs.description_text: About the Role We are looking for a highly motivated and hands-on Battery Engineering Technician to join our battery team in a fast-paced eVTOL startup environment. You will work closely with battery engineers to build, test, and characterize battery modules and packs — from prototype builds through validation. This role requires strong attention to detail, a safety-first mindset, and the ability to adapt quickly to shifting priorities.

jobs.title: Senior Flight Test Engineer
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Flight Test Engineer at Pivotal, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing flight test activities to validate the performance, handling qualities, and safety of our UAS and crewed eVTOL aircraft. This includes developing detailed test plans and procedures, supporting ground and flight tests, and analyzing results to ensure accurate data capture and reporting. You work cross-functionally with engineering, flight operations, and certification teams to ensure all testing aligns with program milestones and regulatory requirements. A strong focus on safety, technical excellence, and continuous improvement is essential in this role as we progress toward certification and commercial operation.

jobs.title: Senior GNC Engineer - Flight Controls
jobs.description_text: About the Role The GNC team at Pivotal develops the flight control and navigation algorithms that let our aircraft fly safely and precisely, including on the Helix family of aircraft. We are looking for a Senior GNC Engineer to design, tune, and verify flight control laws for our aircraft, taking them from analysis and simulation through flight test. You will own the control laws for specific flight modes and control loops within the architecture set by the team’s technical leads. That includes analysis and tuning with CONDUIT, system identification to support our models, Monte Carlo and mission-level verification, and flight test support. You will work closely with the navigation, firmware, aeromechanical, systems engineering, and flight test teams, and help mentor less experienced engineers. The ideal candidate is a fully qualified flight controls engineer who works independently, has designed and tuned control laws that were evaluated in flight test or piloted simulation, ideally on VTOL, rotorcraft, or eVTOL aircraft, and brings sound judgment to interpreting analysis and test results.

jobs.title: Staff GNC Engineer – Flight Controls
jobs.description_text: About the Role The GNC team at Pivotal develops the flight control and navigation algorithms that let our aircraft fly safely and precisely, including on the Helix family of aircraft. We are looking for a Staff GNC Engineer to lead flight control law development on an aircraft program: owning the control law architecture and its design, tuning, and verification from simulation through flight test. You will set the technical direction for how our aircraft are controlled in hover, transition, and forward flight. That includes defining the control law architecture and design criteria, using system identification and flight data to improve our models, and making sure the control laws meet stability, performance, and handling qualities requirements. You will also be a team lead for flight controls, setting priorities for the team, overseeing its technical work, and mentoring the engineers on it, while working closely with the navigation, firmware, aeromechanical, systems engineering, safety, and flight test teams. The ideal candidate has a track record of taking flight control laws from design to flight on real aircraft, ideally VTOL, rotorcraft, or eVTOL, and the judgment to make sound design and flight test decisions with incomplete information. This role is a strong next step for an engineer who has grown through hands-on flight controls work and is ready to lead a team.

jobs.description_text: Your role in our mission We are seeking a Sr. Application Security Engineer to join our security team. In this role, you will be a critical partner to engineering, product, and SRE teams, helping to identify, assess, and mitigate security risks across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will drive security by design, shape our product security standards, and ensure vulnerabilities are identified, tracked, and resolved efficiently. This is a hands-on technical role. You’ll lead secure architecture and design reviews, code reviews, and penetration testing, and you’ll be a core part of how Prosper builds and uses AI securely. That covers threat modeling agentic systems, red teaming AI applications, building AI defenses, and assessing AI risk across internal tools and vendors. The expected working hours for this role are based in Pacific Time. Compensation details: The salary for this position is $190k - $220k annually, plus bonus and generous benefits.

jobs.title: FP&A Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description_text: About the Role As our FP&A Intern, you’ll work on the numbers leadership uses to run the company. You’ll help build the annual plan, quarterly forecasts, and long-range models, and you’ll present your work to our senior leadership team. You’ll report to the FP&A Manager and work on the real plan, the real forecasts, and the materials that go in front of our board. Neighbor is a two-sided marketplace, which makes the finance work here unusually interesting. You’ll dig into how supply and demand grow market by market, what drives our take rate, and what it costs to acquire a host or a renter. By the end of the summer, you’ll own expense forecasting for the entire business. This internship is a direct path to a full-time role. Strong performers leave with a full-time offer to join the team after graduation.

As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for setting the vision, defining the strategy, and driving the execution of a meaningful part of our marketplace. You will pioneer a standard of customer obsession, analytical rigor, and AI-augmented velocity that makes Neighbor fundamentally better for our hosts and renters across all 50 states.

jobs.description_text: About the Role Neighbor is a two-sided marketplace for self storage and vehicle storage. Hosts list everything from garages and driveways to RV pads and commercial facility units, and renters compare options, book, and manage reservations through Neighbor’s website and apps. You’ll report directly to a Co-Founder and our VP of Product & Design, and you’ll set the bar for design craft across the company. That means mentoring Neighbor’s other designers, shaping product direction with PMs and engineers from the first sketch, and making sure real renter insight reaches every team. Renters on Neighbor compare everything from storage facility units to neighborhood garages and RV pads. Helping them choose with confidence is a hard design problem, and solving it moves the business directly. This role is based in our Lehi, Utah office, in person Tuesday through Friday, with the option to work from home on Mondays.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer - Data Connectors
jobs.description_text: The Role The Connectivity team builds the software that connects Palantir’s platform to customer systems. Our connectors integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. From large datasets to real-time events and user-driven interactions, these connections underpin the applications and AI workflows customers build with Foundry and AIP. You’ll build and maintain Foundry’s first-class connector suite and the shared infrastructure behind it. You’ll work across the stack, taking ownership of connector implementations, developer SDKs, and the systems that build, test, distribute, and run our connectivity software. A central part of this work is evolving and scaling a large, established codebase. You’ll move integrations from bespoke infrastructure onto shared platform capabilities, design SDKs that enable other teams and customers to build integrations independently, and safely retire older implementations. You’ll also build observability and diagnostic tools that help users understand, monitor, and troubleshoot their connections. You’ll own improvements from design through production and use what you learn from operating connectors to strengthen the platform they share.

Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality. If you believe in the transformational power of data and technology and in your own ability to bring that power to bear against complex problems, we want to meet you. What We Do As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most challenging problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be. Deployment Strategists are do-ers who immerse themselves in our customers' most intricate workflows, partner with customer teams and explore the data, and dive into the product landscape to enable us to scale. A select number of Deployments Strategists may also be deployed to Palantir internal teams and problems. We help our customers detect insider trading, improve disaster relief, fight healthcare fraud, and more. Each mission presents different challenges, from the regulatory environment to the nature of the data to the user population. You will work to accommodate all aspects of an environment to drive real technical outcomes for our customers. You will collaborate closely with project managers, superintendents, subcontractors, and design teams to ensure that all MEP work aligns with project drawings, specifications, commissioning plans, and owner requirements. Experienced coordinators may take on more complex systems integration responsibilities, lead commissioning meetings, work directly with owners and facility teams, assist in resolving field‑driven MEP challenges, and support continuous improvement in project execution. Successful team members in this role are committed to accuracy, system performance, safety, problem‑solving, and delivering excellent results throughout construction and commissioning.

We design, build, and launch the world's largest and most advanced satellite constellation that is capable of delivering high-speed internet to even the most remote locations. As a CVD Equipment Engineer for our solar cell factory, you will own the PECVD equipment used to manufacture silicon heterojunction solar cells at massive scale. You will work closely with our existing CVD Process Engineering team to ensure world-class equipment performance, reliability, and uptime. While the process team focuses on film properties and cell efficiency, you will be the hardware owner responsible for tool availability, stability, and scaling to support our ambitious goals. Your work will form the backbone of the Starlink network (photons of sunlight in is directly proportional to photons of data out to customers!) and help provide internet to tens of millions of customers all around the world. You will spearhead state of the art production equipment for an internal solar cell production line, providing high efficiency and high-quality solar cells for both our latest generation Starlink satellites and for Starship missions to the Moon and Mars.
